validated_claims.topic: External SLM source and applicability access
validated_claims.result: model_context preserves complete research and explanation_sources for every matched prefix, including applicability, claim-level evidence, interpretation limits and value/subkey source records. Its semantic_edges also retain their sources and explanations. node-records.jsonl and graph/snapshot.json preserve the complete authored records.

Families and each node’s prompt variants are deterministically kept together. train-edge-index contains only edges with two train endpoints. The export explicitly warns that related concepts, ancestors and documentation can overlap; full graph exports are transductive; this is a small pilot rather than independent real-log generalization. No contrary independent-generalization claim was found in this module.

validated_claims.topic: Personal files and safe destination handling
validated_claims.result: Ordinary and changed-graph refreshes preserve personal.txt; an initial node-records.jsonl collision is rejected without changing that file; a symlink output root is rejected without touching its target.

Focused tests cover schema2-to-schema3 Vault refresh, personal annotation preservation and rejection of a newly reserved CONCEPTS.md user-file collision. Existing Vault validation derives the generated file set from canonical graph content rather than granting deletion authority to arbitrary manifest entries.

limitations: A factual source review is still required: these schema and projection tests do not verify that Windows claims are true.

Full node records, snapshot and model context carry full research. SFT messages are task-specific projections: explain_prefix includes applicability, while interpret_path_only carries log context and limits. Consumers wanting the entire research bundle should use node-records.jsonl or model_context, not just the SFT messages array.
related_nodes in compact model_context are ID/path references only; use another lookup or exported node records for a related node’s full applicability and evidence.
Family grouping is a heuristic. Some very small input graphs can have empty validation/test splits, so pilot users must inspect splits.json counts and cannot assume three populated partitions.

Refresh writes are atomic per file with the manifest last, not a whole-directory transaction. Concurrent readers should validate after refresh; interruption recovery and hostile concurrent filesystem mutation are outside these deterministic probes.

Integrity checks detect inconsistent edits, not authenticity: a coordinated rewrite of the canonical snapshot and every derived artifact is a new internally consistent dataset rather than a cryptographically authenticated source.
